page_title: STR 2-2 LEN | Strasbourg v Lens 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Emanuel Emegha is replaced by Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg).
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
85' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andy Diouf.
80' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) comes onto the pitch for Sebastian Nanasi.
78' Will Still is forced to make a change. Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) is unable to continue due to injury, Ruben Aguilar comes on.
76' Lens work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
72' Will Still has decided to substitute Angelo Fulgini and he is replaced by Nampalys Mendy (Lens).
72' Substitution. Wesley Said is replaced by Florian Sotoca (Lens).
70' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
64' Facundo Medina (Lens) receives a yellow card.
63' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
60' 2 - 2 Goal! Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) calmly steps up and places the ball into the bottom right corner.
59' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) is going to take the penalty!
58' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) makes a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Strasbourg!
57' The linesman raises his flag. Wesley Said (Lens) is adjudged offside.
56' Foul! Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
56' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

56' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Djordje Petrovic has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Good work from Lens as they win a corner.
53' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
50' Dangerous play by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens). Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) takes a short corner kick.
49' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Brice Samba has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
46' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) trips an opposition player and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) is replaced by Sekou Mara.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Brice Samba thwarts him with a nice save.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 2 Goal! Andy Diouf (Lens) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
44' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) commits a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) touches the ball with his hand.
42' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
41' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
41' Wesley Said (Lens) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
39' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is adjudged offside.
38' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
38' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
34' Andy Diouf (Lens) commits a rough foul. Stephanie Frappart stops the game and makes a call.
32' Lens take a short corner kick.
30' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Diego Moreira (Strasbourg).
22' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

18' 1 - 1 The ball was swung into the box by Sebastian Nanasi from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg), who planted a bullet header inside the left post to make the score 1:1.
18' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

14' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the left side of the goal, but it lacks power and Djordje Petrovic pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
9' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Adrien Thomasson plays a long ball to M'Bala Nzola (Lens), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the top right corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 0:1.
4' Flag goes up against M'Bala Nzola (Lens) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Strasbourg will take the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart will supervise the game today.
